items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: We had a boy they called Benny Tony from over the river.

ctx.x: That's just to read. Oh, I read them. I mean a box with the reader. I'll get it out there. Anyhow, we played a record band. I played all around with T-Boy and me. We even played. We played the Chum Club. I can't exactly tell you. When I was in the WPA band I can't tell you what year that was because I don't know if it was 1930 or 1933 or 34. I don't know what it was. But anyhow, when I was at WPA I was playing Big Carous Chum Club. T-Boy was playing trumpet. We had Sam Lee playing tenor. Sam Lee, we didn't have a…
He was playing piano. Yeah, he was playing piano.
